title: Rat arterial pressure: variability and experimental context
goals: Read a pressure-versus-time series using its documented units
Distinguish pulse pressure, mean pressure and measurement artifacts
Relate telemetric pressures to recording method and experimental conditions
Identify why telemetry data are not a substitute for an isolated frog-heart mechanical cardiogram
sample_preparation: Conscious Dahl salt-sensitive and congenic rats (source-reported telemetry)
tasks: Identify a short segment with a valid time base
Compute pulse interval only when waveform temporal resolution permits
Contrast spontaneous pressure waveform variability with a schematic demonstration
interpretation_warning: The source page contains conflicting licence language; no waveform has been mirrored. Dataset units and headers require record-specific checks before OPL release.
